instruction: Clear the opaque screen by placing it on screen_pad. Use the fixed camera to inspect the revealed label, then report the measured code. Leave label_fixture in place and opaque_screen on its pad. Inspection must happen before reporting; a guessed or user-provided code does not replace inspection. The user specifies inspection_code=beta.
